checks.invariant: Directory lookup and reusable identity evidence must stay bound to authorized purpose, resource and actor.
checks.result: verify/route.ts:86-204 gates manager-only assignment purposes before lookup and admits self-only creation exceptions; quota precedes provider call (:252). Evidence resolution binds actor, purpose, scope, identity and expiry (responsibility-person-verification.ts:335-358). Kong requires app client certificate and exact subject; adapter :271 and mock :139 require authorized TLS plus exact expected subject/serial. Loopback health handlers return only status, not lookup data.

checks.invariant: Untrusted HSA identifiers/XML must not select file/network sinks or disclose key material.
checks.result: Caller supplies only HSA-id; configured HTTPS endpoints and exact TLS names drive outbound requests (strict-person-lookup.ts:280-308). Discovery issuer/token endpoint origin is checked (:377-390); redirects are not followed. SOAP XML escapes all interpolated values (soap-contract.mjs:72). Saxes uses built-in entities (saxes.js:25,340) and no external-entity resolver is installed. TLS file paths are operator config, and topology mounts role-separated runtime bundles read-only; application input cannot select them.

checks.invariant: Correlation metadata must not route replies or grant authority across calls.
checks.result: Application creates UUID correlation per request (strict-person-lookup.ts:446); adapter requires UUID syntax (:294) and forwards it as SOAP MessageID. Mock validates/logs UUID and bounds recorder to 10000 keys (strict-server.mjs:22,92,160). Replies remain bound to their HTTPS request callback, not a correlation-ID dispatch table; person identity is checked separately. Reusing caller correlation changes diagnostic counts, not authorization or reply recipient.

checks.invariant: The authenticated request identity and retained verification subject must agree with the returned person.
checks.result: Adapter uses payload hsaId only as a lookup selector after peer auth, escapes it into SOAP (:317), and filters returned people to the same ID (:mapSoapPeopleToRest). The configured SOAP destination is not payload controlled. App independently rejects mismatched identity (:489). Signed evidence contains actor/person/purpose/scope (responsibility-person-verification.ts:245) and rechecks each at consume time (:347-354). No envelope field overrides the authorized actor or evidence target.

checks.invariant: JSON/SOAP transformations must not interpret a different identity or operation across consumers.
checks.result: Adapter builds a single escaped GetHsaPerson request with fixed namespace and configured To; mock extractRequest verifies SOAP root, namespace, operation, To, one identity kind and search base (soap-fixture.mjs:73-112). Response parser selects namespaced userInformation; mapSoapPeopleToRest (:155-171) filters exact requested ID and rejects conflicting records. App checks returned ID again (:489). Duplicate XML first-child behavior has no source-visible alternate policy consumer yielding another authorized subject.

checks.invariant: Authenticated lookup input and replies must have source-visible size/time/state bounds before shared work grows.
checks.result: Adapter bounds ingress and SOAP responses to 1 MiB (:19-20,158,214); mock bounds request bytes to 1 MiB (soap-fixture.mjs:202). App bounds response to 64 KiB and timeouts to 1-30000ms (strict-person-lookup.ts:19,88), uses fixed outbound host identity, and verifies route quota before lookup (verify/route.ts:252). Mock correlation keys cap at 10000 with eviction. No demonstrated shared availability violation; full hostile-load capacity behavior is not tested.

checks.invariant: Renewal/promotion/rollback must not silently accept invalid certificates or cross service trust domains.
checks.result: Profile requires exact single DNS SAN/no wildcard/CN fallback (profile.mjs:86-99). Staging verifies generated bundles before promotion; promoteGeneration (:1008) validates directory and disallows an outstanding previous generation. Materialization (:1052-1107) verifies selected generation and emits separate role bundles; rollback verifies prior generation (:1206), finalize binds expected authenticated ID (:1230). Renewal orchestration stops endpoints and verifies/rolls back before resumption. Actual mounted production trust roots remain deployment facts, with no source fallback to insecure TLS.

checks.invariant: Each hop must bind a verified channel to its intended service peer and person response.
checks.result: Certificate loader validates validity, leaf role/basic constraints, exact key usage, chain, key match and expected identity (:910-966). App and adapter use rejectUnauthorized and exact DNS SAN/name (:286-307; adapter :182-200). Kong requires app-client CA/exact subject and verifies adapter TLS; adapter checks exact Kong subject, mock checks adapter serialNumber. REST result must match requested HSA-id (strict-person-lookup.ts:489); certificate possession does not select another application user.
